claims.text: The 2013 excerpts remain the only public view of the interior of the intelligence budget; every other public figure is an aggregate. Reasoning: no subsequent leak or FOIA release has produced a comparable programme-level NIP summary, and the statutory disclosure regime at 50 U.S.C. 3306 requires only aggregates.
The DCI disclosed $26.7 billion for FY1998; disclosure then lapsed until the DNI released the FY2007 NIP figure.
The 1997 litigation was brought by the Federation of American Scientists with the assistance of Kate Martin of the Center for National Security Studies.
